title: Two Fixed Ends Are Enough To Quantise A String
summary: Drive a stretched wire at any frequency and it ignores you, until it does not. Nothing in the equation of motion picks out the frequencies it accepts: the clamps do, and stiffness then spreads them apart.

sources.title: Fletcher and Rossing, The Physics of Musical Instruments, 2nd edition, chapters 2 and 12
Morse and Ingard, Theoretical Acoustics, chapter 4
Young, Inharmonicity of plain wire piano strings, Journal of the Acoustical Society of America 24 (1952) 267-273
